description: The Sydney, Australia network from Veitch Lister Consultancy, provided by M. Bliemer and converted by D. Rey. From Transportation Networks for Research, the traffic assignment test networks that continue H. Bar-Gera's TNTP collection: a directed road network with link capacities and free-flow times and an origin-destination trip table, in the files Sydney_net.tntp and Sydney_trips.tntp.zip of the repository at commit d1639b4ef218.

licence.name: Transportation Networks for Research terms: academic research purposes only, with the source indicated in any publication

name: TNTP Sydney traffic assignment network

recipe.reason: Its link lines are not ended by the ; the TNTP format requires, and its trip table is distributed only as a zip inside the repository (Sydney_trips.tntp.zip), which a parts archive does not unpack. It becomes fetchable when the source terminates its link lines and keepset reads a part from an archive inside the download.
